title: Moon phases & eclipses
examples: Why does the moon change shape in the sky?
What is the difference between a solar and lunar eclipse?
Does the moon make its own light?

explain.say: The moon does not make its own light.
Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: the phases of the Moon. Look at the sunlight, the earth and the new moon. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
The moon shines because it reflects the sun's light.
The moon goes through different shapes called phases.

draw.text: Moon phases: New, Crescent, Quarter, Gibbous, Full

explain.say: A solar eclipse happens when the moon blocks the sun.
A lunar eclipse happens when the earth blocks the moon.
When the moon is between the earth and sun, it is a solar eclipse.

faq.q: Why does the moon change shape?
faq.a: We see different amounts of the sunlit side of the moon over time. This is because the moon orbits the earth.
asks: Why does the moon look different each night?

faq.q: What is the difference between a solar and lunar eclipse?
faq.a: In a solar eclipse, the moon passes between the sun and earth. In a lunar eclipse, the earth passes between the sun and the moon.
asks: Which object blocks the sun during an eclipse?
When does the earth block the moon?

faq.q: Can we see the moon phases every night?
faq.a: No, because the moon takes about one month to complete one full cycle. It is always moving around the earth.
asks: How long is the moon cycle?
Do the moon phases happen every day?

faq.q: Does the moon make its own light?
faq.a: No, the moon only reflects the light that comes from the sun. It acts like a mirror in space.
asks: Where does the moon get its light?
Is the moon a light source?

faq.q: Are solar and lunar eclipses always visible?
faq.a: No, they can only be seen from specific locations on earth at specific times. You must be in the right place.

facts: The moon orbits the earth, which causes the phases.
A full moon means the entire face of the moon is lit by the sun.
A new moon means the moon is between the earth and the sun.
During a solar eclipse, the moon passes between the sun and earth.

quiz.say: If the earth is in the middle, what kind of eclipse happens?
quiz.why: The earth passing between the sun and the moon causes the moon to pass through earth's shadow.

wrong.0: This happens when the moon blocks the sun, not when the earth is in the middle.
wrong.1: An alignment is needed for an eclipse to occur.
wrong.2: A full moon is a phase, not a type of eclipse.

quiz.say: When the moon is completely dark, what phase is it?
quiz.why: During the new moon, the moon is positioned between the earth and the sun, so we cannot see its lit side.

wrong.0: A full moon means the entire moon is visible and lit.
wrong.1: A quarter moon means exactly half the moon is lit.
wrong.2: Waning describes the moon getting smaller, not being completely dark.

quiz.say: What must happen for a solar eclipse to occur?

options.show: Moon and Earth are far apart
options.say: Moon and Earth are far apart

quiz.why: The moon must pass directly between the sun and the earth to block the sun's light.

wrong.0: The bodies must line up closely for the shadow to fall correctly.
wrong.2: This alignment causes a lunar eclipse, not a solar one.
wrong.3: The sun is the light source and cannot be between the other two bodies.
